title: The Morning Digest: November 17, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled $92.44, down $3.40 or 3.6 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled $85.72, down $2.84 or 3.2 percent on Monday (Reuters, Nov 16), and Asia extended the move to Brent $91.62 and WTI $84.89 at 0720 GMT on Tuesday (Reuters, Nov 17), with the Brent to WTI spread steady near $6.73. December WCS is -$28.22 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 16) on zero lots, an eighth straight session without a December trade, and December nominations close at 0700 MST on Tuesday with the registered call at Light 14 percent and Heavy 9 percent. UKMTO issued a third incident warning late Monday, for an attack reported north of Khasab. The validated diesel crack is $82.11 on the latest print.
